pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Whispered Narration Intro]
(soft sogeum airy breath, gentle gayageum harmonics and warm ajaeng drone, signature hook melody introduced softly in first 10 seconds)

끝없이 무너졌던 마음에
작은 숨결 하나 스며와
허공에 흩어지던 조각들 다시 모아

[Verse 1]
(low ajaeng sustained notes with delicate gayageum plucks, subtle janggu rhythm building gentle hope)

말라버린 눈물 조차
새벽 이슬처럼 내려와
차갑게 식은 상처들을 조용히 감싸 안을게

[Pre-Chorus]
(gayageum arpeggio rising with warmth, ajaeng glissando, percussion slowly layering, taepyeongso soft bright tease)

희미하게 반짝이던 빛이
내 그림자 옆을 비춰주고

[BUILD]
(janggu & buk rolls increasing density, ajaeng pitch rising, deep sub bass rumble growing, sogeum ornamentation adding emotional tension)

[DROP]
(silence 0.6sec → immediate heavy punch: deep sub bass + janggu/buk powerful hit, taepyeongso lead dominates with soaring hopeful melody, gayageum rhythm flowing through)

나는 다시 태어난다
빛의 자리에서 rise again
무너진 나를 안아주네
새로운 하루가 온다 tonight

[Chorus]
(full traditional fusion groove, bright female vocal full of healing emotion, male deep low harmony anchoring warmth)

나는 다시 태어난다
빛의 자리에서 rise again
더는 울지 말라고 괜찮다고
가만히 나를 안아주네

[Verse 2]
(softer ajaeng long tones, gayageum delicate strums, male low vocal adding tender strength)

바람에 스친 외로움도
한 장의 추억으로 남겨
숨조차 버거워 막혔던 나의 이름을 다시 불러

[Rap Break]
(male deep aggressive rhythmic rap, driving janggu & buk with afrobeat groove, ajaeng low warm stabs, taepyeongso short bright motifs)

Yo, pieces scattered in the dark, now gathering in my hands
Broken days behind me, stepping into light again
Ajaeng whispers healing, gayageum strings rebuild my soul
Taepyeongso calls me forward, making broken whole
Bass drop heavy but the warmth cuts through the pain
From the ruins I rise, in this Joseon night I remain

[BUILD 2]
(denser percussion layers, rising taepyeongso wail with trills, full sub bass swell, maximum hopeful tension)

[DROP 2]
(immediate heavy impact, taepyeongso lead stronger with soaring melody and trills, full percussion explosion, female bright emotional adlib)

나는 다시 태어난다
빛의 자리에서 rise again
무너진 나를 안아주네
새로운 하루가 온다 tonight

[Final Chorus]
(maximum energy, layered male & female vocals, full instrumentation with powerful hook repetition)

나는 다시 태어난다
빛의 자리에서 rise again
더는 울지 말라고 괜찮다고
가만히 나를 안아주네
나는 다시 태어난다
빛의 자리에서 rise again
무너진 나날을 건너온 끝에
비로소 빛이 나를 찾아와

[Outro]
(fade with sogeum soft air, lingering gayageum harmonics and warm ajaeng drone, whispered male "I’m reborn... in the light")
pkg.sunoStyle:
Korean traditional fusion EDM with afrobeat groove.
Instruments: gayageum, ajaeng, taepyeongso, sogeum, janggu, buk, kkwaenggwari, jing.
Bass: deep sub bass, strong, punchy, clean from kick.
Drums: afrobeat groove + Korean traditional rhythm.
Drop: instant hit after build, bass + Korean percussion dominate. Taepyeongso or ajaeng lead within 0.3 sec. Kkwaenggwari for tension only, jing for resonance.
Vocal: female bright and emotional. male deep, thick, heavy and resonant.
Male rap: aggressive, rhythmic, low-register English rap.
Structure: build → drop → chorus. 100-110 BPM.
Atmosphere: traditional + modern + cinematic Joseon night vibe.
Restrictions: no modern synth lead, no weak bass, no thin vocal, traditional instruments must remain clearly recognizable.
